mapper.sql: order_id orderId, community_id communityId,user_id userId,app_id appId,mch_id mchId,order_type orderType,provider_version providerVersion,total_fee totalFee,payload,state,transaction_id transactionId
mapper.select: select from payment_order where order_id=#{orderId} for update

select po.order_id from pay_fee_detail d inner join fee_receipt_detail rd on rd.detail_id=d.detail_id and rd.fee_id=d.fee_id and rd.community_id=d.community_id inner join fee_receipt r on r.receipt_id=rd.receipt_id and r.community_id=rd.community_id inner join bill_owe_fee bof on bof.community_id=rd.community_id and bof.fee_id=rd.fee_id and rd.start_time=bof.fee_end_time and rd.end_time=bof.deadline_time and rd.amount=bof.bill_amount_owed inner join payment_order_item item on item.owe_id=bof.owe_id inner join payment_order po on po.order_id=item.order_id and po.community_id=r.community_id and r.amount=po.total_fee/100 where d.detail_id=#{detailId} and d.fee_id=#{feeId} and d.community_id=#{communityId} and po.state='POSTED' and po.provider_version in ('V2','V3') limit 1 for update
select case when count(*)=1 and min(mch_id)=#{mchId} then 1 else 0 end from small_wechat where obj_id=#{communityId} and obj_type='1000' and appId=#{appId} and status_cd='0'
select order_id from payment_order_reservation where community_id=#{communityId} and fee_id=#{feeId}
select fee_id from pay_fee where community_id=#{communityId} and fee_id=#{feeId} for update
select order_id from payment_order_reservation where community_id=#{communityId} and fee_id=#{feeId} for update

select detail_id from pay_fee_detail where community_id=#{communityId} and fee_id=#{feeId} and status_cd='0' and received_amount > 0 and coalesce(state,'1400') not in ('1100','1300') and (end_time is null or end_time > #{feeEndTime}) and (start_time is null or start_time < #{deadlineTime}) limit 1 for update
mapper.sql: bof.owe_id oweId,bof.bill_id billId,bof.fee_id feeId,bof.bill_amount_owed billAmountOwed, DATE_FORMAT(bof.fee_end_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') feeEndTime, DATE_FORMAT(bof.deadline_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') deadlineTime, bof.owner_id ownerId,bof.owner_name ownerName,bof.payer_obj_name payerObjName, bof.payer_obj_type payerObjType,pf.payer_obj_id payerObjId,pfc.fee_name feeName, bof.community_id communityId

from bill_owe_fee bof inner join bill b on b.bill_id=bof.bill_id and b.community_id=bof.community_id inner join pay_fee pf on pf.fee_id=bof.fee_id and pf.community_id=bof.community_id and pf.status_cd='0' inner join pay_fee_config pfc on pfc.config_id=pf.config_id and pfc.community_id=pf.community_id and pfc.status_cd='0'
mapper.select: select where bof.owe_id=#{oweId} and bof.bill_id=#{billId} and bof.community_id=#{communityId} and b.review_state='PUBLISHED' and bof.state in ('1000','3000') and pf.end_time=bof.fee_end_time for update
mapper.delete: delete from payment_order_reservation where community_id=#{communityId} and fee_id=#{feeId} and order_id=#{orderId}
mapper.update: update payment_order set transaction_id=#{transactionId} where order_id=#{orderId} and state='CREATED' and transaction_id is null
update bill_owe_fee set state='2000',fee_end_time=fee_end_time where owe_id=#{oweId} and community_id=#{communityId} and bill_id=#{billId} and state in ('1000','3000')
update bill set receipts=coalesce(receipts,0)+#{billAmountOwed},bill_time=bill_time where bill_id=#{billId} and community_id=#{communityId} and review_state='PUBLISHED'
update payment_order set state='CLOSED' where order_id=#{orderId} and provider_version='V3' and state='CREATED'
update payment_order set state='POSTED',posted_time=current_timestamp where order_id=#{orderId} and transaction_id=#{transactionId} and state='CREATED'
